_doc: Planks: sawn at the sawmill from wood (logs). Grain: reaped at a farm; flour: milled from grain; bread: baked from flour, and what the town eats (#99). Coal, iron ore and gold ore: dug at the mines (#42). Iron: smelted from iron ore and coal; tools: forged from iron and planks, what every trade works with (#102). Gold (smelted from gold ore) is the game's own. Pigs: fattened on grain; sausages: a butcher's, eaten as bread is (#103). Grapes: picked from vines; wine: pressed from them at the vineyard, drunk at the inn (#122). Wood, stone and food are the game's own.
